summary: Tested PDF export functionality for LUIGGI HOME ERP/CRM. Found and FIXED critical bug: TypeError 'doc.autoTable is not a function' caused by incorrect jspdf-autotable v5 import. Changed from side-effect import to functional import pattern. PDF export now works correctly.

fixed_issues.issue: TypeError: doc.autoTable is not a function - jspdf-autotable v5 requires functional import pattern
fixed_issues.fix_applied: Changed import from 'import jspdf-autotable' (side-effect) to 'import autoTable from jspdf-autotable' and updated all doc.autoTable() calls to autoTable(doc, {...})

critical_code_review_comments: jspdf-autotable v5.x requires functional import pattern: import autoTable from 'jspdf-autotable' and use autoTable(doc, {...}) instead of doc.autoTable({...})
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF export functionality is now working. The fix involved updating jspdf-autotable import pattern for v5 compatibility. Login with MARIO/MARIO, add manual line, fill description and points, click EXPORTAR PDF - PDF downloads successfully with budget data.

bug_rca.issue: TypeError: doc.autoTable is not a function
bug_rca.root_cause: jspdf-autotable v5.0.7 changed the import/export pattern. The side-effect import 'import jspdf-autotable' no longer extends jsPDF prototype correctly in modern bundlers
reproduction_steps: 5. Error appears: doc.autoTable is not a function
bug_rca.fix: Changed import to functional pattern: import autoTable from 'jspdf-autotable' and replaced all doc.autoTable({...}) calls with autoTable(doc, {...})
